title: test(plugin-auth): register the #8243 rotation cases only in their own file, not in the 32 suites that import its double
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHbvKE5cT3AmzSZKFm5wgRg)_

Part of #23181 (slice 30, the seat's ruling D on report `6555141723`). The card stays open for later slices.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts` 只在自己是 vitest 正在运行的那个文件时才注册它的 10 个 #8243 用例（`expect.getState().testPath` 与本模块路径比较）；另外 6 个导入它的测试文件里，以「代价已测量」为由解释导入的注释改为现状。共享的 `createMemoryEngine` 替身、两个门禁台账、32 处 import 行都不动。
- **为什么改**：32 个测试文件从这个测试文件导入替身，每次导入都把那 10 个用例在导入方里重新注册一遍，同样 10 个用例每轮跑 33 次（#23181 测试提速职责）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件；plugin-auth 的 `files[]` 只发 `dist`、README、CHANGELOG，不发布任何东西。模块级钩子（console 桩、`restoreAllMocks`、scrypt 记忆）仍不加守卫，24 个只靠这次导入拿到 scrypt 记忆的文件照旧拿到。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts`（`isEntry` 守卫；用 `git diff -w` 看，除守卫外只有缩进变化）；`admin-impersonate-endpoint.test.ts` 第 32–43 行的注释。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts src/admin-has-permission-endpoint.test.ts` → 前者 10 个用例、后者 3 个（base 上后者是 13 个）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts`: the three top-level `describe.concurrent` blocks (the ten #8243 cases) are wrapped in `if (isEntry) { … }`, where `isEntry = expect.getState().testPath === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`. A comment says why (#23181 slice 30, the 32 importers). The precedent is `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lock-one-resolution.kit.test.ts`. `git diff -w` shows only the guard, its comment, the `fileURLToPath` import and a re-worded #23184 comment above it (which said the cases still run in importers). Every case keeps its body and assertions. The export and the double are byte-identical. The module-scope hooks stay unguarded: the console stubs, `afterEach(restoreAllMocks)`, and `memoizeScrypt()` with `afterAll(restore)`.
- Prose in importers. Import lines do not change. `git grep` over the 32 importers for comments justifying the import by its cost, or saying the bearer-rotation cases run there:
  - `admin-impersonate-endpoint.test.ts`: the "re-registers … 10 rotation tests also execute" sentence and "Ten duplicated hermetic tests is the cheapest of the four." are replaced by one sentence: the file registers its `describe`s only when it is the one run. The reason to import (one double in both gates' sight) stays.
  - `platform-admin-standing.consolidation.test.ts` and `session-positions-security-axis.test.ts`: "re-registering that file's `describe`s here is cheaper than minting a second engine double" becomes "sharing its double is better than minting a second engine double".
  - `admin-impersonate-endpoint`, `platform-admin-standing.consolidation`, `session-grants-resolved-once`, `two-factor-reenrollment-verified-reset` and `two-factor-rotated-token-echo`: in the vendor-preload comment, "(and the bearer-rotation cases it imports)" becomes "(and, until #23181 slice 30, the bearer-rotation cases it imported)". The preload lists themselves are untouched.
  - Left as they are, because they are still true: `bridge-redispatch-transport.pin.test.ts` line 36 and `sso-domain-verification-unknown-provider.pin.test.ts` line 123 (the import still registers `afterEach(restoreAllMocks)` in the importer).

## Tests

Probe, a throwaway run with two temp files deleted after. A module that reads `expect.getState().testPath` at collection sees the file vitest is collecting, in all three runs:

```text
=== run: kit alone
PROBE kit-module: testPath=…/zzprobe-kit.test.ts own=…/zzprobe-kit.test.ts isEntry=true          Tests 1 passed (1)
=== run: importer alone
PROBE kit-module: testPath=…/zzprobe-importer.test.ts own=…/zzprobe-kit.test.ts isEntry=false
PROBE importer-module: testPath=…/zzprobe-importer.test.ts                                     Tests 1 passed (1)
=== run: both in one invocation
PROBE kit-module: testPath=…/zzprobe-importer.test.ts … isEntry=false
PROBE kit-module: testPath=…/zzprobe-kit.test.ts … isEntry=true                                Tests 2 passed (2)
```

Each file gets its own module graph (vitest's default `isolate: true`; neither plugin-auth's config nor CI turns it off), so the module is evaluated again per file and the reading is per file.

Count and wall A/B on one box: the full plugin-auth suite in separate invocations, interleaved base, head, base, head, base, head, in one lock hold. Base `ce001f97` was swapped in for the 7 files and HEAD restored after; `git diff HEAD` was empty at the end.

| run | base | head |
|:--|--:|--:|
| tests (all runs identical) | 3943 passed, 10 skipped (3953) | 3623 passed, 10 skipped (3633) |
| package wall, s | 266.7 / 263.5 / 262.1 (mean 264.1) | 256.6 / 255.8 / 246.1 (mean 252.8, −4.3%) |
| sum of all 207 default-reporter file lines, s | 229.6 / 224.6 / 225.0 | 205.0 / 205.8 / 194.0 (−11%) |
| sum of the 32 importers' file lines, s | 86.7 / 85.3 / 85.0 | 65.0 / 63.4 / 61.0 (−26%) |

- The fall is exactly 320 = 10 × 32, and every exit is 0. From the JSON reporter, per file: each of the 32 importers falls by exactly 10. `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts` runs 10 before and 10 after. The other 174 files' counts are identical. Run alone, `impersonation-bearer-rotation.test.ts` reads 10/10 at head.
- The package wall falls less than the summed file lines because the run is bound by workers and module collection, not by these cases.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (tsc, examples, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- No ablation: test-only, and no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- `// test-budget:` headers: none added or changed (order item 6).
- The hidden limit-blind `find` double in `plugin-sharing/src/exec-context-seam.testkit.ts`, and whether the two double gates should walk `*.testkit.ts`, are filed by the seat as a finding for triage. They are not in this PR.

## Verification

- Head `31320abb`. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 51 families. All 51 were run after a full `turbo run build` (118/118) and all exit 0. `--ran` reports: 51 accounted, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `check:engine-double-contract`: exit 0, 1060 rows held by the RETAINED ledger, as on base. `check:objectql-double-limit`: exit 0, "baseline key set verified … no files added". Neither ledger file is in the diff.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 7 files: exit 0. plugin-auth has no lint script.
- `check-commit-card-trailers --range ce001f97..HEAD`: exit 0.
- `skip-changeset`: plugin-auth's `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the diff is `*.test.ts` only. No `files[]` changes.
